verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs explicitly state connectors 'automatically sync' data with 'incremental syncs automatically' and no pipelines to maintain, plus dedicated sync-mode and delete-capture features (soft delete, live, history modes) and per-connector re-sync controls, all indicating managed cursor/state logic rather than full reloads. Community comments corroborate that Fivetran's syncing is reliable and saves engineers from building this logic themselves, though one anecdote notes an occasional full re-sync was needed as a fallback (a minor real-world caveat, not a contradiction of the core capability). Missing for 10: independent technical detail on cursor/state internals and broader third-party confirmation beyond a couple of anecdotal HN mentions.
